files.run.json: Immutable model architecture, fast tokenizer, trainable parameters, config snapshot and optional parent checkpoint
files.last.pt: Latest complete training state; atomically replaced after a successful save
files.best.pt: Optional best validation checkpoint; saved explicitly by the engine

workflows.pretrain: Set INIT_CHECKPOINT=None and RESUME_CHECKPOINT=None; use current config and pretrained BERT/DINO weights to create a new run
workflows.finetune: Set INIT_CHECKPOINT to a source checkpoint and RESUME_CHECKPOINT=None; inherit model architecture, weights, tokenizer and trainable parameters, use current training settings and create a new run with fresh optimizer, scheduler, EMA, queue and progress
workflows.resume: Set RESUME_CHECKPOINT and INIT_CHECKPOINT=None; restore saved settings and training state, override only DEVICE from current config and keep saving into the checkpoint directory
workflows.inference: Call load_pretrained(path) to reconstruct model/tokenizer offline; returns model in CPU eval mode and saved config without restoring training state

rules: Copy the entire run directory when moving checkpoints
Save after optimizer/scaler, scheduler and EMA/queue updates, with no pending accumulated gradients
epoch and next_batch identify the next batch to process; global_step counts successful optimizer updates
epoch and next_batch resume data iteration through deterministic epoch replay; data_state also stores best_val_loss and last_validation_step
Do not reseed after load_checkpoint restores RNG state

Engine resume requires matching DATA_FINGERPRINTS (SHA-256 of train/validation manifests and SQLite caches) and BATCHES_PER_EPOCH; missing fingerprints require INIT_CHECKPOINT; individual image bytes, source hashes and library versions are not checked
manager.json describes this format; run.json stores reconstruction metadata for each run
Old checkpoint formats are not loaded automatically
User settings live in src/config.py; MODEL_VERSION labels architecture, not checkpoint format
MODEL_VERSION does not select model code automatically; retain the corresponding Git tag or commit for each implementation
INIT_CHECKPOINT and RESUME_CHECKPOINT are mutually exclusive
New runs use CHECKPOINT_DIR/MODEL_VERSION/RUN_NAME unless create_run receives an explicit run_dir; an existing directory is rejected
Resume ignores current MODEL_VERSION and RUN_NAME for its save location; use the returned settings throughout training
Do not edit run.json after saving checkpoints; each checkpoint stores a digest of the complete metadata
Rebuild LambdaLR from saved settings and the same number of batches per epoch before restoring its state
prepare_training creates EMA and queue, plus GradScaler only when AMP_ENABLED=True and AMP_DTYPE=float16; queue dimensions come from the loaded model
Use low-level checkpoint APIs to resume runs created with different training components

run_training saves last.pt periodically and at completion, validates on schedule and at completion when enabled, and saves best.pt for lower finite validation loss; zero intervals disable periodic events; best loss and last validation step persist in data_state
Image IDs are signed int64 BLAKE2b hashes of DATASET_NAMESPACE, a null separator and the normalized path relative to IMAGE_DIR
Queue state stores image_ids aligned with image/text features; preserve namespace and relative paths when relocating a dataset
Format 4 checkpoints lack queue image IDs and are rejected; no automatic migration is provided
